findings_to_judge.finding: FuelCell's own careers site right now shows 61 of its 80 open requisitions at the Torrington cell plant and, critically, an entire third shift being staffed end-to-end -- Supervisor Tape Casting (Third Shift), Sheet Metal Supervisor (Third Shift), Warehouse Supervisor (Third Shift), Material Handler (Third Shift), QA Inspector Manufacturing (Third Shift), EH&S Specialist (Third Shift), Facility Tech (Third Shift), Janitor (Third Shift) and Security Officer (3rd Shift), plus a parallel second-shift set -- i.e. a 24/7 line being commissioned, not incremental backfill.

Homer John Livingston III, who only became a FuelCell director on 19 May 2026, bought 26,343 shares in the open market on 16 July 2026 at a weighted-average $18.79 (about $495k, transaction code P, direct) -- an actual cash purchase at a company where every other recent insider line is a director-fee stock grant or a 10b5-1 sale.

The Fit Energy CEPA's only alignment mechanism -- 12,000,000 warrant shares in three 4m tranches, each vesting only on FuelCell receiving a non-refundable deposit equal to 16% of the order value for the next 100 MW -- is struck at $26.44, now 58% above the $16.72 spot, and in the ten weeks since signing there has been no 8-K, no press release, no named data-centre site and no phase election; FuelCell's press-release feed shows nothing operational since 9 July, against management's own commitment to convert submitted proposals into contracted backlog 'within this fiscal year' (FY ends 31 October).
